reason: Adds proxy expiry and fallback metadata so admins can expire proxy nodes, select backup proxies, and restore account proxy assignments after fallback.
risk: The migration adds NOT NULL columns with defaults to proxies and creates normal indexes without CONCURRENTLY, which can briefly lock the proxies and accounts tables during deployment.
mitigation: The change is additive and idempotent, uses nullable foreign key and origin columns for existing rows, and defaults fallback behavior to none. Run during the normal dev deploy window and keep the existing deploy health checks in place.
